subject: mathematics
content: A tangent to the ellipse x<sup>2</sup> + 4y<sup>2</sup> = 4 meets the ellipse x<sup>2</sup> + 2y<sup>2</sup> = 6 at P and Q. Prove that the tangents at P and Q of the ellipse x<sup>2</sup> + 2y<sup>2</sup> = 6 are at right angles.
